metadata.name: Remind me
metadata.description: Use “Remind me” in Recued. Capture a one-shot personal reminder as a Recued task. Resolve the requested time against the current date/time in your context, in the user's timezone, and pass remindat as an absolute ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit offset.
metadata.author: recued-core

reminder_text.label: Reminder text
reminder_text.help: Bare reminder text to show when the reminder fires.

remind_at.label: Remind at
remind_at.help: When the reminder should fire, as an absolute ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 date-time WITH a timezone offset (e.g. 2026-07-04T15:00:00-07:00 or 2026-07-04T22:00:00Z). Resolve the user's requested time against the current date/time in your context, in the user's timezone — do NOT assume UTC; if the timezone is unknown, ask before guessing. An offset-less value is rejected.

container_names.label: Destination container
container_names.help: Optional. File the reminder in a named vendor container, keyed by its dependency ref: { 'project': 'Roadmap' } (Asana) or { 'team': 'Core' } (Linear). Leave empty to use the Source's default destination.
